edit.description: the discipline gate that reads the committed declaration's rails
the engine fact the gate needs to reach a committed declaration
the rails the refusal keys on — the seam shared with the gate-reader entry
the chain load no surface hands out today
the refusal cases, one per rail, and the environment-only pass

summary: the package refuses a build commit that changes the fence, the gates or the agents a phase runs under; the rest of the declaration stays build's to edit
acceptance: a build commit editing the declaration's fence, gates or agents is refused naming which rail moved, and one editing only the environment the declaration states lands
tests: a build commit widening the declared fence is refused naming the fence
a build commit hanging a new gate on a phase is refused naming the gates
a build commit changing a phase's declared agent is refused naming the agents
a build commit that changes only the environment the declaration states passes the rails gate
notes: Build's fence already names `.flume/declaration.ts`, so this refusal is the only thing holding a tick off its own rails. No surface hands the package a declaration at a ref or at a tree: `loadChainModule` is unexported and `chainLoadGate` loads one and discards it — a fact the engine holds unreported (`engineering.md`, *A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered*).
